talking_points: Jensen Huang tried to project business as usual at Nvidia's HQ this week, but the board's affair probe now shadows next week's earnings and the China chip debate.
Google just pushed two new custom TPU chips, including one built for confidential AI training, in a fresh swipe at Nvidia's dominance.
Oura ditched its stalled IPO plans and instead spent $625 million buying an AI doctor startup, showing acquisitions are filling the gap left by a jittery IPO market.
